ladder.label: COUNTER-TREND BOUNCE
ladder.why: Short-term, a daily bottoming setup is forming — but the bigger picture is bearish (weekly momentum negative; investor cycle failed (broke its start low)). A bounce here is COUNTER-TREND: daily-cycle lows that don't line up with a weekly-cycle low tend to be left-translated and fail, then cascade toward the larger cycle low — exactly the trap of buying a daily low in a falling investor cycle.
ladder.next: Nimble traders only — small size, tight stop below 2935.19. Not an investment buy; wait for the weekly timeframe to actually turn up (or a fresh investor-cycle low to confirm) before trusting it.
ladder.regime_why: weekly momentum negative; investor cycle failed (broke its start low)
ladder.regime_line: Bigger picture: BEARISH — weekly momentum negative; investor cycle failed (broke its start low) (investor cycle week 12 · failed · daily cycle day 10).
ladder.summary_line: Short-term (daily): counter-trend bounce. Bigger picture (counter-trend): bearish.
points: Bigger picture is bearish (counter-trend for a daily long)
Macro: US net liquidity neutral — no macro tilt on the odds
Swing low printed (buyers rejected the low)
Back above the 10-day average, and it's turning up

entry.text: Counter-trend bounce inside a bearish bigger picture. For nimble traders only — small size, tight stop below 2935.19. If the daily low fails it cascades toward the larger cycle low; not an investment buy.
entry.text_zh: 处于看空大局中的逆势反弹。仅限灵活交易者——小仓位、将止损紧贴 2935.19 下方。若日线低点失守，将向更大周期低点蔓延；并非投资性买入。

cycle_plain.daily_line: Daily cycle: day 10 of a typical 36–42 trading days
cycle_plain.daily_phase: fresh — a new cycle just started
cycle_plain.daily_line_zh: 日线周期：第 10 天，典型周期为 36–42 个交易日
cycle_plain.weekly_line: Weekly (investor) cycle: week 12 of a typical 16–26 weeks
cycle_plain.weekly_phase: mid — the bigger up-leg is maturing
cycle_plain.weekly_line_zh: 周线（投资者）周期：第 12 周，典型周期为 16–26 周
cycle_plain.weekly_phase_zh: 中期——更大的上行段正在成熟
cycle_plain.translation: The last cycle peaked in its SECOND half ('right-translated') — strong cycles top late, a healthy-uptrend sign.
cycle_plain.translation_zh: 上一周期在后半段见顶（“右移”）——强周期见顶偏晚，属于健康上涨趋势的信号。

ladder.why_zh: 短期来看，正在形成日线筑底形态——但大局看空（weekly momentum negative; investor cycle failed (broke its start low)）。此处的反弹属于逆势：与周线周期低点不对齐的日线周期低点往往呈左移结构并最终失败，随后向更大周期低点蔓延——这正是在下行的投资者周期中买入日线低点的陷阱。
ladder.next_zh: 仅限灵活交易者——小仓位、将止损紧贴 2935.19 下方。并非投资性买入；在采信之前，请等待周线周期真正转向上行（或出现新的投资者周期低点予以确认）。
ladder.regime_line_zh: 大局：看空 — 周线动量为负；投资者周期失败（跌破起始低点）（投资者周期第 12 周 · 已失败 · 日线周期第 10 天）。
ladder.summary_line_zh: 短期（日线）：逆势反弹。大局（逆势）：看空。
points_zh: 大局为看空（对日线多头而言属逆势）
宏观：美国净流动性中性——对概率属无方向性影响
摆动低点已现（买方拒绝了该低点）
重新站上 10 日均线之上，且均线开始向上
ladder.liq_line: US net liquidity is neutral right now — no macro tilt either way on the odds.
ladder.liq_line_zh: 美国净流动性目前中性——对概率没有方向性影响。
ladder.age_line: ⏱ COUNTER-TREND BOUNCE signal triggered 5 trading days ago (~2026-06-05), switching from DOWNTREND. Signal strength: mild (score -25/100).
ladder.age_line_zh: ⏱ 逆势反弹信号于 5 个交易日前触发（约 2026-06-05），自下跌趋势切换而来。 信号强度：温和（评分 -25/100）。
ladder.eq_label_zh: 入场质量：偏弱高风险反弹（+25）
ladder.eq_tip: How well-timed & low-risk THIS entry is — near the cycle low, a fresh momentum turn, and with-trend. Measured: entries near the pivot drew ~30% smaller drawdowns than chasers far above it — risk control, NOT a return forecast.
ladder.eq_tip_zh: 衡量当前入场的时机与风险——贴近周期低点、动量新近转向、且顺势。实测：贴近枢轴的入场，其回撤比远离枢轴的追高者约小 30%——这是风险控制，并非收益预测。

profile.description: AutoZone, Inc., doing business as AutoZone, is an American retailer of aftermarket automotive parts and accessories, the largest in the United States. Founded in 1979, AutoZone has 7,140 stores across the United States, Mexico, Puerto Rico, Brazil, and the US Virgin Islands.
profile.description_zh: AutoZone公司以AutoZone名义经营，是一家美国售后汽车零部件和配件零售商，为美国最大。成立于1979年，AutoZone在美国、墨西哥、波多黎各、巴西和美属维尔京群岛拥有7,140家门店。
